dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, linear narrowing of the 2D geometric footprint from the mid-dorsal region toward the posterior terminus.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Asymmetrical structural deviation visible on the upper-left margin relative to the straighter right margin, manifesting as a localized lateral bulge.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white with low-intensity blue-grey saturation across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transition along the lateral margins where the depigmented body meets the turbid water environment.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A series of distinct, circular, high-contrast light spots located on the left dorsal plane; one prominent, white longitudinal linear mark extending along the upper central axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent longitudinal white scar or pronounced ridge alignment along the midline of the anterior-to-mid dorsal section.
